Photoreal live-action, London, March 1881, iron grate, black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:08. The camera is beside the chair arm at the height of his chest, an arm's length from the fist, a 90mm lens. The fire comes from the LEFT onto the knuckles. At the first frame the fist and the crumpled paper fill the CENTRE of the frame, the height of the middle third, on the worn chair arm. The chair's far side is black at the RIGHT edge. The camera tilts up across the whole shot, travelling a finger's breadth, and the fist lifts off the chair arm a hand's breadth from the first frame as the paper's edge crumples in the fingers, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 the fist keeps the frame's centre, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:08 the camera is tilting up through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
